question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes! I ship worldwide. Domestic shipping (US) is included in the price. International shipping is calculated based on destination and package size. All artwork is carefully packaged with protective materials.
answerEs: Si! Envio a todo el mundo. El envio domestico (EE.UU.) esta incluido en el precio. El envio internacional se calcula segun el destino y el tamano del paquete. Toda la obra de arte se empaqueta cuidadosamente con materiales protectores.
